Add a reference-only server definition (disabled unless sync-all is on)

Usage: larp cc mcp add [OPTIONS] <--command <ABSOLUTE>|--url <SAFE_URL>> <NAME>

Arguments:
  <NAME>  Server name: 1-32 characters from a-z, 0-9, '-', '_', starting with a letter

Options:
      --command <ABSOLUTE>
          Absolute path of a local server executable
      --json
          Emit one local metadata JSON envelope
      --arg <SAFE_ARG>
          Only --stdio or --transport=stdio; pass as --arg=--stdio
      --expected-revision <EXPECTED_REVISION>
          Refuse if the registry revision has changed
      --env-ref <VAR>
          Environment variable NAME passed by reference, never its value
      --url <SAFE_URL>
          https URL whose path is exactly /mcp or /sse
      --header-ref <HEADER=ENV_VAR>
          HEADER=ENV_VAR reference, never a header value
  -h, --help
          Print help
